connector.name: Steam MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Steam store/game data (no key) plus player profiles, libraries and achievements (Steam Web API).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package steam-games-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the grinv account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: STEAM_API_KEY
env.description: Free Steam Web API key (optional). Unlocks player profile, library and achievement tools.

env.name: STEAM_ID
env.description: Default player: 17-digit SteamID64 or vanity name (the part after /id/).

env.name: STEAM_COUNTRY
env.description: Two-letter ISO country code for store prices (e.g. US, GB, DE).
